candidates.description: This feature represents political and socio-economic ideologies, systems, and their associated terminology.
This vector represents abstract concepts, propositions, plans, and narratives.
This feature activates for terms, roots, and foreign words related to concepts, philosophies, and systems of thought or belief.
This feature vector represents noun-forming suffixes and words containing nominal suffixes related to action or state across Romance and Germanic languages.
These tokens represent morphological suffixes for noun and adjective derivations, particularly related to the concepts of "action" and "ization" across various Romance and Germanic languages.
This vector represents modal auxiliary verbs expressing ability, possibility, or obligation across multiple European languages.
These tokens function as grammatical connectors and adversative or conditional conjunctions/prepositions that establish logical relationships, exceptions, or contrasts between clauses.
This feature vector represents ideological, philosophical, and agent-based suffixes and related socio-political terms.
This vector represents past-tense transitive action verbs indicating completed events or transactions.
This feature vector represents common French grammatical function words, particularly auxiliary verbs and frequent prepositions.
